inspection_by_skill_id.nda-return-copy-retention-evidence: Separate the three tasks before deciding. For return/destruction, verify that the operative trigger is termination, expiration, abandonment, or conclusion of the contemplated relationship; a duty triggered only by request does not establish termination-triggered return. For copying, an express exception allowing necessary, automatic, or purpose-limited copies supports permission, while “no copying without consent” is a conditional prohibition rather than affirmative permission and can oppose the hypothesis; retention of an existing copy does not itself authorize creating it. For post-return possession, require an explicit retention exception, such as archival, backup, legal, regulatory, evidentiary, or professional-record retention. A command to return or destroy all originals and copies with no exception can oppose retention; silence is insufficient. Read the whole return section, including lead-ins, alternative triggers, exceptions, and continuation conditions, and inspect the complete source when search fragments omit deletion or a linked exception.
inspection_by_skill_id.nda-definition-form-identification-evide: Apply distinct tests. Explicit identification asks whether every protected item must be marked, designated, identified, or later confirmed by the disclosing party. A mandatory identification condition supports it; an express alternative based on circumstances, nature, or what the recipient should reasonably understand opposes the universal requirement. Mere absence of marking language does not by itself settle the issue. Technical-only scope is opposed when the definition expressly includes business, financial, marketing, customer, personnel, contractual, or other nontechnical matter; do not infer scope from an isolated generic reference. Verbal inclusion requires definition language covering oral, verbal, spoken, nonwritten, or information regardless of communication form, including any stated identification formalities. Reconstruct definitions continued across sentences or lists, retaining the governing definition and responsive categories; distinguish inclusions from exclusions and unrelated disclosure provisions. If a query returns only a fragment, inspect the complete definition in the original source.
inspection_by_skill_id.nda-exception-source-development-evidenc: Keep independent development and third-party acquisition analytically separate. Development is supported by an operative exclusion or right covering information developed independently, normally qualified by no access to, reference to, or use of protected information and sometimes by contemporaneous proof. Prior possession or creation before disclosure is not the same as later independent development. Third-party acquisition requires an operative exclusion or permission tied to a source other than the discloser, usually conditioned on lawful receipt, a nonconfidential basis, and the source’s lack of a confidentiality duty. An “independently acquired or developed” formulation may address both, but a mere acknowledgment that similar information may be received from others is not necessarily permission. Do not transfer a development qualification to the third-party task or vice versa. Read the exception preamble with the item and preserve provenance, timing, knowledge, access, proof, and confidentiality qualifications. Search the full exclusions and any separate independent-development section when the returned fragment is incomplete.
inspection_by_skill_id.nda-authorized-recipient-evidence: For each task, identify an operative permission to disclose or grant access, then resolve the permitted class. Employee sharing requires that the receiving party’s employees are within that class; third-party sharing requires nonemployees such as agents, contractors, consultants, counsel, accountants, advisers, financing sources, or other representatives. A representative definition is useful only when connected to an operative disclosure or access clause. Preserve need-to-know, stated-purpose, confidentiality-undertaking, consent, and responsibility conditions. Do not treat a clause merely naming representatives, the disclosing party’s personnel, solicitation targets, or persons receiving information from the recipient as authorization. An employee-only exception to a general nondisclosure rule may support employee sharing while opposing broader third-party sharing; a broad representative permission can support both only if its definition actually contains both classes. Read cross-referenced definitions and the complete disclosure clause, especially where the permission and recipient list appear in different provisions.
inspection_by_skill_id.nda-rights-license-purpose-evidence: Decide no-grant and limited-use independently. For no-grant, look for operative language reserving ownership or rights and stating that no licence, proprietary right, or right in the protected information is conveyed. Mere access, disclosure, review, or permission to use information for an evaluation is not an unrestricted rights grant and does not by itself oppose no-grant. Conversely, an express licence must be evaluated by its object and scope: a narrow licence to background intellectual property may coexist with a broader reservation concerning confidential information. For limited use, require an operative restriction such as solely, only, exclusively, except for the stated purpose, or a prohibition on own-benefit or other-purpose use. A disclosure restriction alone is not a use restriction. Follow purpose definitions and split lead-ins, and retain qualifications or later agreements that alter the permitted use. Do not let evidence for one task determine the other; inspect the full rights and use provisions when searches return only ownership, access, or transaction language.
inspection_by_skill_id.nda-agreement-negotiation-secrecy-eviden: Test whether the protected subject is the fact, existence, occurrence, status, content, or terms of the agreement, negotiations, discussions, or contemplated transaction—not merely the underlying confidential information. An express ban on revealing that discussions are occurring, their status or terms, or a public announcement concerning the agreement can support the hypothesis even when consent, legal-compulsion, or audience exceptions apply. The same result may follow when the definition expressly makes negotiation facts confidential and an operative nondisclosure duty governs that definition; retrieve both parts. General confidentiality language does not suffice unless agreement or negotiation information is brought within its scope. Preserve the governing prohibition, relevant list items, consent and compelled-disclosure exceptions, and audience limitation. Inspect the complete source for definitions and public-announcement provisions when phrase searches return no direct negotiation clause.
inspection_by_skill_id.nda-survival-continuity-evidence: Require language connecting continued effect to termination, expiration, completion, abandonment, or an equivalent endpoint. Identify exactly which obligations continue, for how long, and under what release, trade-secret, retained-material, or other condition. Split sentences must be read together when the survival rule and duration are separated. Do not infer survival from a right to terminate, a fixed agreement term, a return/destruction duty, or language saying duties continue only during the agreement’s term. Continuation after return or destruction is relevant only if the source also makes clear that this event corresponds to or extends beyond the contractual endpoint. Retained-material clauses may establish continuing application to retained information, but their temporal relation must be checked. Preserve contrary termination language and exceptions rather than forcing a result. Inspect termination, duration, return, severability, and retained-record provisions across the complete source because a direct “survive” search may miss functionally equivalent continuity language.
inspection_by_skill_id.nda-compelled-disclosure-notice-evidence: Establish a linked trigger-duty pair: a legal, regulatory, governmental, subpoena, court-order, or similar compulsory request must activate a duty to notify the disclosing party. Preserve whether notice must be prompt, written, prior, as extensive as legally permitted, or subject to a prohibition on notice, plus any opportunity to seek protection or narrow disclosure. A clause permitting legally required disclosure without a notice duty does not suffice; nor does notice of an unauthorized or accidental disclosure. Where the permission says disclosure is allowed only after compliance with another section, inspect that cross-reference for the actual notice mechanism. A notice clause remains responsive when qualified by “to the extent legally permitted.” Retain follow-on limits only when they belong to the same compelled-disclosure mechanism. If the direct query misses, inspect the full compelled-disclosure, subpoena, exceptions, and cross-referenced sections before treating the subject as unsettled.
inspection_by_skill_id.nda-solicitation-restriction-evidence: Start from the operative restriction, not an exception containing the word “solicitation.” For the exact hypothesis, determine whether the receiving party or its affiliates or representatives are barred from soliciting for hire, employing, recruiting, or initiating employment contact with officers, employees, or other personnel of the disclosing party. Follow the clause through all enumerated target classes, duration, consent or approval requirements, contact-based limitations, and exceptions for unsolicited approaches, former employees, general advertising, or nonspecific recruiters. Such exceptions narrow the prohibition; they do not reverse it. Proxy solicitation and standstill provisions are a distinct mechanism: retain them when independently operative and responsive to the broader evidence request, but do not use proxy language alone as a substitute for a personnel or representative target. Headings, definitions, and carve-outs without their parent prohibition are insufficient. Inspect adjacent list items and the complete section whenever a query lands only on an exception.
